headline: Actress Pori Moni gets bail after surrendering in assault case
summary: The actress surrendered to the court and was granted bail with a 500 taka bond.
details: Actress Pori Moni surrendered to the court in connection with an assault case.
Following her surrender, the court granted her bail with a personal bond of 500 taka.
The actress appeared visibly upset and angry in the court premises, questioning the audacity of those involved in the assault.
The case involves allegations of physical assault, leading to the actress to surrender and seek bail from the court.

headline: 33 BGB platoons deployed as BGB deploys drones for surveillance in industrial areas
summary: Border Guard Bangladesh is using drones, body-worn cameras, and armored vehicles to monitor garment workers' unrest in Dhaka and neighboring districts.
details: Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) has deployed 33 platoons to maintain security in industrial areas of Dhaka and neighboring districts following garment workers' unrest.
The force is utilizing drones for live surveillance and body-worn cameras to monitor security operations and prevent untoward incidents.
Deployment details include 12 platoons in Gazipur, 11 in Savar and Ashulia, seven in Narayanganj, and three in Mirpur.
Armoured Personnel Carriers (APCs) and Riot Control Vehicles (RCVs) have also been deployed to strengthen security and respond to emergencies.
A dedicated monitoring cell at BGB headquarters is overseeing and coordinating these activities round the clock.
BGB personnel are coordinating with local administrations and police to ensure public safety and protect industrial establishments.
caption:
Drones and armored vehicles are now on the streets. BGB has deployed 33 platoons to monitor industrial zones.

Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) has deployed 33 platoons to maintain security in industrial areas of Dhaka and neighboring districts following garment workers' unrest.

The force is utilizing drones for live surveillance and body-worn cameras to monitor security operations and prevent untoward incidents.

Deployment details include 12 platoons in Gazipur, 11 in Savar and Ashulia, seven in Narayanganj, and three in Mirpur.

Armoured Personnel Carriers (APCs) and Riot Control Vehicles (RCVs) have also been deployed to strengthen security and respond to emergencies.

A dedicated monitoring cell at BGB headquarters is overseeing and coordinating these activities round the clock.

BGB personnel are coordinating with local administrations and police to ensure public safety and protect industrial establishments.
